Highly recommended and not forgetting to mention, costs a lot less than in SG (the crown costs less than half of my first one) while able to enjoy a relaxing holiday here in Phuket!! Double thumbs up for Dr Pook, Dr Tanya and the team at Dental Plus Patong!

Last November 2025, I visited this dental practice for a check-up costing THB 1,000.00.
Afterward, I was recommended a root canal treatment for THB 14,000.00, and since I had planned another five weeks in Phuket in mid-January 2026, we immediately scheduled an initial appointment for the treatment on January 19th.

After the third appointment, I was politely but firmly informed that I owed an additional THB 21,000.00 for a crown.

These additional costs/work were never communicated to me beforehand.

Furthermore, the nice dentist managed to show up at least 15 minutes late for three out of four appointments.

The fact is: instead of THB 14,000, I ended up paying THB 35,000.00… One can only hope that this doesn't happen to anyone else.
